params.body:
This side no longer ingests a report; it receives one. The Studio holds the
calendar and the file, and `gentells:reconcile` pulls both.

Needs Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#177 (the shelf and the projection endpoints)
and Trendwolves/gentells-studio#19 (the screen).

## What goes away

- **`gentells:report`**, the artisan command that took a PDF over ssh and
  rasterised it here. Its own docblock wanted publishing a report to be possible
  without a developer, and it was the reason it was not: it needs poppler on a
  box Forge does not provision, and there is no sudo here to add it.
- **`ReportCalendarSeeder`**. A calendar in a seeder cannot be changed without a
  commit and a deploy, so a new date needed a developer too. The two tests that
  leaned on it now lay the rows down themselves, which is what the reconcile
  writes anyway.

## What arrives

- **`reconcileReports()`**, with the three rules of this class intact. Rule 3
  has teeth here because there are files: a report weighs 24MB, a failed fetch
  must not make a deliverable report undeliverable, and the fingerprint keeps a
  scheduled job from moving the whole shelf every time a timestamp moves.
- **`Report::forgetFile()`**. Taking a report off the site in the Studio has to
  remove the PDF here too; clearing the column alone leaves it on disk for
  anyone who ever saw the name.
- **`file_sha256`** on reports.

## Two bugs the tests caught first

A refetch wrote straight over the live file, so a 503 halfway through deleted a
report that had been fine a minute earlier. Downloads now land beside the target
and move into place only once they are whole.

The preview staging area sat inside the directory the cleanup wipes, so the new
pages were deleted before they could be moved in. It is now a sibling.

283 tests pass, 7 of them new.
params.title: Reports arrive through the projection, like everything else
